@title CarbonyxCredit
 @notice Self-contained ERC20-style carbon credit token (1 CBX = 1 tCO2e).
         Whole tokens only (0 decimals), because a credit is one tonne of
         CO2-equivalent.
         Credits can only be minted against a registry project that is in
         the Verified state, by the project owner, once per project, and
         the quantification report hash is anchored in the mint event.
         Retiring (burning) is permanent and emits a CreditsRetired event.
